clauses.title: Parties and Demised Premises
clauses.text: This Residential Tenancy Agreement is made and entered into on this 1st day of January 2026, by and between Mr. Rajesh Sharma (hereinafter referred to as the 'Landlord') of the FIRST PART, and Ms. Priya Verma (hereinafter referred to as the 'Tenant') of the SECOND PART. The Landlord hereby lets and the Tenant agrees to take on rent the residential premises located at Flat 402, Greenview Heights, Sector 14, Gurugram, Haryana.
clauses.preview: Identifies Landlord Mr. Rajesh Sharma and Tenant Ms. Priya Verma letting Flat 402, Greenview Heights.

clauses.title: Term and Commencement
clauses.text: The initial term of this tenancy shall be for a duration of 11 (eleven) months commencing on January 1, 2026, and expiring on November 30, 2026, unless renewed earlier by mutual written agreement. Any renewal shall require a fresh written agreement executed at least 30 days prior to the expiration of the ongoing term with mutually agreed escalation in rent.
clauses.preview: 11-month lease term from Jan 1, 2026 to Nov 30, 2026, requiring 30 days renewal notice.

clauses.title: Monthly Rent and Late Fees
clauses.text: The Tenant shall pay to the Landlord a monthly rent of ₹20,000 (Rupees Twenty Thousand only) on or before the 5th day of each calendar month in advance via direct electronic bank transfer. In the event of default or delayed payment, the Tenant agrees to pay a late payment fee of ₹500 per day of delay calculated from the 6th day of the month until the entire outstanding sum is remitted in full. Continued default exceeding 15 days shall constitute grounds for immediate termination.
clauses.preview: Tenant must pay ₹20,000 monthly rent on or before the 5th. Late fee of ₹500/day applies upon delay.

attention_flags.title: Conditional Duty Detected
attention_flags.description: Contains 1 obligation(s) subject to preconditions or exceptions.

clauses.title: Security Deposit and Refund
clauses.text: The Tenant shall deposit and maintain with the Landlord an interest-free refundable security deposit of ₹60,000 (Rupees Sixty Thousand only) upon execution of this agreement. The Landlord shall refund the security deposit within 30 days following the peaceful surrender of the premises, subject to permitted deductions for unpaid rent, unpaid utility dues, or documented structural damages beyond normal wear and tear.
clauses.preview: Security deposit of ₹60,000 to be refunded within 30 days post-tenancy subject to deductions.

attention_flags.title: Conditional Duty Detected
attention_flags.description: Contains 1 obligation(s) subject to preconditions or exceptions.

attention_flags.title: Financial Consequence or Penalty
attention_flags.description: Specifies monetary penalties, late fees, or forfeiture terms upon default.

clauses.title: Utility Bills and Municipal Outgoings
clauses.text: The Tenant shall promptly pay all charges for electricity, water, cooking gas, and high-speed internet consumed within 7 days of receiving the respective bill. The Tenant shall furnish copies of paid utility receipts to the Landlord upon request no later than the 10th of each calendar month. The Landlord shall remain solely liable for statutory property tax and building capital society sinking funds.
clauses.preview: Tenant pays utility charges within 7 days of invoice and furnishes receipts on request.

attention_flags.title: Conditional Duty Detected
attention_flags.description: Contains 1 obligation(s) subject to preconditions or exceptions.

attention_flags.title: Time-Sensitive Requirement
attention_flags.description: Contains tight timelines or immediate performance requirements.

clauses.title: Maintenance and Structural Repairs
clauses.text: The Landlord shall complete necessary major structural and plumbing repairs within 7 days of written notification from the Tenant, provided such damage is not caused by the willful negligence or misuse of the Tenant. The Tenant is responsible for day-to-day cleanliness, waste disposal, and minor repairs of fuses, light bulbs, tap washers, and fittings at their own expense throughout the subsistence of the tenancy.
clauses.preview: Landlord completes structural repairs within 7 days. Tenant handles day-to-day minor repairs.

attention_flags.title: Conditional Duty Detected
attention_flags.description: Contains 1 obligation(s) subject to preconditions or exceptions.

attention_flags.title: Time-Sensitive Requirement
attention_flags.description: Contains tight timelines or immediate performance requirements.

clauses.title: Permitted Use and Prohibitions
clauses.text: The Tenant agrees to use the premises strictly for private residential accommodation and shall not operate any commercial enterprise, business, or illegal activity therein. The Tenant shall not sublet, assign, or part with possession of the premises or any part thereof to any third party without obtaining prior written approval from the Landlord.
clauses.preview: Strictly residential use. Commercial operations and unauthorized subletting are prohibited.

attention_flags.title: Time-Sensitive Requirement
attention_flags.description: Contains tight timelines or immediate performance requirements.

clauses.title: Landlord Right of Inspection and Entry
clauses.text: The Landlord or their authorized agent shall give at least 24 hours prior written notice before entering the premises for physical inspection or repair assessment. The Tenant shall permit inspection access during reasonable daylight hours between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM following due notice, except in case of urgent emergency involving water leakage or fire.
clauses.preview: Landlord must provide 24 hours written notice before entering for daylight inspection.

attention_flags.title: Conditional Duty Detected
attention_flags.description: Contains 1 obligation(s) subject to preconditions or exceptions.

clauses.title: Alterations and Improvements
clauses.text: The Tenant shall not carry out any structural alterations, permanent wall drillings, or repaintings without prior written consent from the Landlord. In the event of unapproved modifications, the Tenant shall restore the premises to its pristine original condition at the Tenant's sole expense prior to final vacation.
clauses.preview: Structural alterations require prior written consent. Tenant must restore unauthorized changes.

attention_flags.title: Time-Sensitive Requirement
attention_flags.description: Contains tight timelines or immediate performance requirements.

clauses.title: Termination and Notice Period
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement prior to the expiry of the lease term by providing at least 30 days prior written notice to the other party. If the Tenant vacates without serving the mandatory 30 days notice, the Landlord shall be entitled to forfeit one month's rent in lieu of notice. The Landlord may terminate with 7 days notice in the event of persistent breach of covenant.
clauses.preview: 30 days prior written notice required by either party for early termination.

attention_flags.title: Conditional Duty Detected
attention_flags.description: Contains 1 obligation(s) subject to preconditions or exceptions.

attention_flags.title: Financial Consequence or Penalty
attention_flags.description: Specifies monetary penalties, late fees, or forfeiture terms upon default.

clauses.title: Surrender of Premises and Key Handover
clauses.text: The Tenant shall surrender vacant possession and return all original keys and access fobs to the Landlord by 12:00 PM on the final day of the tenancy. If the Tenant fails to vacate upon expiry or termination, the Tenant shall pay an unauthorized holding over charge of ₹2,000 per calendar day until actual possession is delivered.
clauses.preview: Tenant must return keys by 12:00 PM on final day. Unauthorized stay incurs ₹2,000/day charge.

attention_flags.title: Financial Consequence or Penalty
attention_flags.description: Specifies monetary penalties, late fees, or forfeiture terms upon default.

clauses.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
clauses.text: This Agreement shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of India and the courts at Gurugram shall have exclusive jurisdiction. Both parties agree to attempt amicable conciliation within 15 days of written notice of any controversy prior to initiating formal arbitration proceedings under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
clauses.preview: Disputes subject to 15 days amicable conciliation before formal arbitration under Indian law.

benchmark_samples.trigger: Beginning of each calendar rental month
benchmark_samples.deadline_text: on or before the 5th day of each calendar month
benchmark_samples.consequence: Late payment penalty of ₹500 per day of delay
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Tenant shall pay to the Landlord a monthly rent of ₹20,000 on or before the 5th day of each calendar month in advance.

benchmark_samples.trigger: Failure to pay rent on or before the 5th day
benchmark_samples.condition: If rent remains unpaid beyond the 5th day
benchmark_samples.deadline_text: immediately upon demand or with next installment
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: In the event of default, the Tenant agrees to pay a late fee of ₹500 per day until the entire outstanding amount is remitted.

benchmark_samples.consequence: Non-delivery of possession of the premises
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Tenant shall deposit and maintain with the Landlord an interest-free refundable security deposit of ₹60,000 upon execution of this agreement.

benchmark_samples.trigger: End of tenancy and peaceful surrender of premises
benchmark_samples.condition: Subject to permitted deductions for unpaid rent, utilities, or documented structural damage
benchmark_samples.deadline_text: within 30 days following the handover of peaceful vacant possession
benchmark_samples.consequence: Statutory interest penalty of 9% per annum on withheld amount
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Landlord shall refund the security deposit within 30 days following the peaceful surrender of the premises, subject to permitted deductions.

benchmark_samples.deadline_text: within 7 days of receiving the respective invoice or bill
benchmark_samples.consequence: Disconnection penalty and Landlord settlement recovery
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Tenant shall promptly pay all charges for electricity, water, and high-speed internet consumed within 7 days of receiving the respective bill.

benchmark_samples.action: Furnish utility payment receipts to Landlord
benchmark_samples.deadline_text: no later than the 10th of each calendar month
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Tenant shall furnish copies of paid utility receipts to the Landlord upon request no later than the 10th of each month.

benchmark_samples.action: Complete major structural and plumbing repairs
benchmark_samples.trigger: Tenant reports qualifying major defect in writing
benchmark_samples.condition: Damage not caused by willful negligence of Tenant
benchmark_samples.deadline_text: within 7 days of written notification from the Tenant
benchmark_samples.consequence: Tenant right to repair and deduct reasonable costs from subsequent rent
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Landlord shall complete necessary major structural and plumbing repairs within 7 days of written notification from the Tenant.

benchmark_samples.object: Internal fixtures, light bulbs, minor drain cleanings
benchmark_samples.deadline_text: throughout the subsistence of the tenancy
benchmark_samples.consequence: Deduction from security deposit upon vacating
benchmark_samples.evidence_text: The Tenant is responsible for day-to-day cleanliness and minor repairs of fuses, tap washers, and fittings at their own expense.
